primitives.name: Project Space Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Scope This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces, and it also applies when an individual is representing the project or its community in public spaces.
primitives.assumptions: Boundary B is defined by spatial and representational contexts; P is a topological manifold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: B(P) fails when external representation lacks internal validation.

layer2.mapping: Project space B(P) maps to GSI behavioral state space; GSE enforces boundary transitions via agent feedback loops.

primitives.name: Enforcement Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Enforcement Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported by contacting the project team at [`engineering@polymarket.com`](mailto:engineering@polymarket.com).
primitives.assumptions: E(R) is a stochastic process with probabilistic outcome distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E(R) becomes undefined when R is unreported or misclassified.

layer2.mapping: Enforcement E(R) derived from GSI incident classification; GSE triggers corrective state transition.

primitives.name: Confidentiality Guarantee
primitives.verbatim_quote: The project team is obligated to maintain confidentiality with regard to the reporter of an incident.
primitives.assumptions: C(R) is a cryptographic or procedural invariant under adversarial conditions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C(R) degrades when R is exposed or compromised.

The system assumes that representation of the project extends beyond physical boundaries into public discourse, thus requiring a consistent normative framework. The enforcement protocol is modeled as a stochastic process where reports are evaluated and resolved, with confidentiality guarantees ensuring trust in reporting. These primitives form a closed-loop system where GSI infers behavioral compliance and GSE manages transitions between normative states. Failure modes occur when boundaries are ambiguous, enforcement is inconsistent, or confidentiality is breached. The system's robustness depends on the consistency of these mappings across layers.
